title: A familiar way into chat
summary:
One chat endpoint gained more models and fewer rough edges, while the projects built on Pollinations became easier to find.

POST `/v1/chat/completions` was added for streaming and non-streaming requests in OpenAI-compatible formats. Cross-domain policies also gave Flash widgets on devices such as Chumby and Sony Dash a way to request text and images. Apparently old hardware still has plans.

The text and chat lineup grew with Gemini Flash Lite, Gemini Thinking, DeepSeek, Mistral Small 24B, Pixtral 12B, `llama-vision`, and Phi-4 Instruct. `openai-reasoning` moved to o3-mini, with vision support listed, and DeepSeek's response limit rose from 4,096 to 8,192 tokens.

Projects moved higher on the homepage, and a new “For Teens 🚀” tab highlights featured projects. New and updated listings ranged from story-making and image apps to a realtime art feed, a food-photo nutrition app, and a community Node.js and TypeScript client for images, text, and speech.

The text client now adapts system prompts for reasoning models that do not accept the system role. Model-specific token defaults help avoid Llamaguard context-window errors when callers omit `max_tokens`, while spacing between requests from the same IP fell from 12 to 6 seconds. Explicit token limits remain unchanged.
